result.brief: 提出无 IMU 的四旋翼机体系状态估计系统，用稀疏场景流与 EKF 输出位姿和点云，属机器人状态估计而非世界模型或表征学习。
result.reason: Vision-only quadcopter state estimation via EKF and bundle adjustment; main contribution is robot state estimation/control, not world modeling or representation learning. World model only mentioned as downstream use.
